Syra — machine-readable API summary (llms.txt)
==============================================

Name: Syra
Tagline: Machine Money for Agents — pay-per-call crypto APIs (x402 USDC).

Base URL
--------
https://api.syraa.fun

Discovery (public, no API key)
------------------------------
GET /openapi.json              — OpenAPI 3.1 gateway catalog (AgentCash / x402scan)
GET /mpp-openapi.json          — MPP registry companion document
GET /.well-known/x402          — x402 resource catalog + payment instructions
GET /x402/capabilities         — live payment networks + facilitator failover
GET /llms.txt                  — this file
GET /llms-full.txt             — full route / pricing reference
GET /skill.md                  — agent skill brief
GET /favicon.ico               — brand mark

How to pay
----------
Paid routes return HTTP 402 with Payment-Required + JSON `accepts`.
Settle the chosen offer, then retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE or X-PAYMENT.

Server accepts (see GET /x402/capabilities):
- Core USDC: Solana, Base
- Multi-chain USDC via PayAI/Dexter: Polygon, Arbitrum, Avalanche, Sei, SKALE, Optimism, World, Monad, Robinhood, …
- Also when enabled: BSC B402, Algorand (GoPlausible), OKX X Layer (USDT0)
- Facilitator failover: Dexter → GoPlausible → PayAI
- MCP/SDK auto-pay signers today: Solana (default), Base, Algorand

Docs: https://docs.syraa.fun/docs/api/x402-api-standard

Start here (flagship paid GETs)
-------------------------------
GET /health                    — paid connectivity probe ($0.001)
GET /news?ticker=BTC           — crypto news
GET /sentiment?ticker=BTC      — sentiment
GET /signal?token=bitcoin      — trading signal
GET /coingecko                 — market scout brief
GET /insights/market-pulse     — SOL/BTC/ETH oracle pulse
GET /brain?question=...        — Syra Brain Q&A

Free onboarding
---------------
GET /free/pillars
GET /free/assets
GET /api/metrics

MCP / SDK
---------
MCP: npx -y @syra-ai/mcp-server@latest
SDK: @syra-ai/sdk — createSyraPaidClient({ baseUrl: "https://api.syraa.fun" })
Docs: https://docs.syraa.fun
Contact: support@syraa.fun
